text.arabic_uthmani: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ

words.gloss_range: lowered, humbled, subdued as a visible circumstantial state of the eyes; locally not voice or earth imagery except as narrowed root-image pressure
words.root_gloss_range: lowering, stilling, humbling, or subduedness across gaze, voice, posture, and land; the local bearer selects lowered gaze/perception

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: their eyes or sight-faculties as the grammatical bearer of the lowered state
the earlier called-for prostration whose refused voluntary lowering contrasts with imposed lowering
the final prior-soundness predicate that frames the ayah with the opening lowered state

words.prose: {{ar:خَٰشِعَةً}} ({{tr:khāshiʿatan}}) opens the ayah with the state before the possessor is named: the first thing seen is lowered abasement. Its accusative participial form makes that loweredness a circumstantial condition, and its feminine singular agreement fastens the state to {{ar:أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:abṣāruhum}}), not to a vague humility of the whole scene. The wider root can describe subdued voice or depressed earth, but here the eyes select the gaze/perception branch. That forced lowering also answers the earlier call to {{ar:ٱلسُّجُودِ}} ({{tr:al-sujūdi}}): voluntary prostration was refused, and visible abasement now arrives as imposed state. The lowered-eyes construction belongs to recognizable judgment diction, including the supplied parallels (54:7, 70:44, 79:9), while the opening and final {{ar:سَٰلِمُونَ}} ({{tr:sālimūna}}) frame the ayah between present abasement and prior soundness.

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as an accusative circumstantial participle in the opening nominal state-clause.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the concrete lowered-and-stilled image of the root while recognizing that the local bearer selects gaze/perception, not voice or earth.
topics.reason: The broader root field includes several domains, but the local noun {{ar:أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:abṣāruhum}}) selects the lowered-eyes reading.

words.prose: {{ar:أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:abṣāruhum}}) names the eyes or sight-faculties as the bearer of {{ar:خَٰشِعَةً}} ({{tr:khāshiʿatan}}). The suffix keeps those eyes tied to the same judged group from the previous ayah, so the humiliation is not generic. The plural form distributes abasement across their perceptive organs or channels, and the root range allows sight to carry more than optics: perception and confidence are also being brought low. The pairing of {{ar:ب ص ر}} ({{tr:b-ṣ-r}}) with {{ar:خ ش ع}} ({{tr:kh-sh-ʿ}}) belongs to a judgment-scene pattern, while the same-surah contrast with aggressive eyes later (68:51) turns sight from attempted force into exposed weakness.

topics.headline: their eyes remain referentially continuous

words.prose: {{ar:تَرْهَقُهُمْ}} ({{tr:tarhaquhum}}) turns the static lowered-eyes image into motion: humiliation is now actively overtaking them. The object suffix makes the judged group the recipients of pressure, while the feminine verb anticipates {{ar:ذِلَّةٌ}} ({{tr:dhillatun}}) as the delayed subject. The root has wider branches of nearness, burden, covering, and even reckless lightness, but the local subject selects the covering-pressure branch: disgrace closes in as an externally imposed force, not merely as an inward feeling. The imperfect keeps that covering vivid and ongoing, and the {{ar:ر ه ق}} ({{tr:r-h-q}}) plus {{ar:ذ ل ل}} ({{tr:dh-l-l}}) pairing belongs to recurring judgment diction, including the supplied exact phrase parallel (10:27).

topics.headline: them as recipients of pressure

topics.reason: The attached 3mp object is syntactically forced as the object of the verb and tracks the same judged group.

topics.headline: imperfect makes covering ongoing

topics.reason: The imperfect verb follows the nominal state-clause and creates verbal motion in the current judgment scene.

topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:ذِلَّةٌ}} ({{tr:dhillatun}}) the explicit nominative subject of the 3fs verb.

topics.headline: causative imposition of disgrace

topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the root's movement from reckless lightness or nearness into heavy consequence, while local syntax selects overwhelming disgrace.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as patterned judgment diction for disgrace overtaking people, including the exact supplied parallel (10:27).

words.gloss_range: humiliation, disgrace, abasement, or loss of autonomy as the nominative subject covering them

words.prose: {{ar:ذِلَّةٌ}} ({{tr:dhillatun}}) is not merely a label for how they feel; it is the nominative subject that does the covering in {{ar:تَرْهَقُهُمْ}} ({{tr:tarhaquhum}}). By delaying the noun until after the verb and object, the clause first lets the pressure land on them and then names its agent as humiliation. The gerund names a state of abasement, while the indefinite form lets that state arrive as fresh, unbounded disgrace. It differs from {{ar:خَٰشِعَةً}} ({{tr:khāshiʿatan}}): both involve lowering, but this word carries evaluative degradation and loss of autonomy, not only subdued posture. Its pairing with {{ar:ر ه ق}} ({{tr:r-h-q}}) also belongs to recurring humiliation-covering diction, and the same-surah echo with punishment announced earlier (68:33) lets this word name the visible form of that consequence.

topics.headline: humiliation acts as subject

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) at this point does more than add another event. Bound to {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}), it opens a retrospective clause that explains the humiliation just shown: they had been called before. The connector therefore links visible consequence to past cause, moving the ayah through its four-beat architecture of lowered eyes, covering humiliation, prior summons, and prior soundness. In the boundary movement, the consequence chain from the previous ayah is answered by this explanation: inability now is set against refused ability then.

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the conjunction as resumptive, introducing the past passive clause.

topics.headline: visible judgment becomes indictment

words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) certifies the past frame before {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}). Because it stands before a perfect auxiliary, its force is assertion or verification, not rarity. The retrospective clause therefore functions as evidence: their prior summons was an established reality, not a hypothetical opportunity. At the hinge after {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}), this particle gives the move from visible consequence to proven cause its assertive weight.

topics.headline: past summons established as fact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior calling is presented as settled evidence, not merely imagined background.
topics.reason: The particle precedes the perfect auxiliary and certifies the past habitual clause.

topics.headline: not an occasionality reading

topics.reason: The CRITICAL row notes alternate particle behavior, but the local perfect auxiliary selects certification.

words.gloss_range: they were; a perfect auxiliary carrying the same plural group and placing the following passive call in prior habitual or continuing time
words.root_gloss_range: being, occurring, becoming, past predication, and existence-framing; locally the auxiliary branch temporalizes the following imperfect passive

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the passive imperfect predicate governed by the auxiliary

words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) is the hinge that relocates the summons into prior history while keeping its imperfect texture. With {{ar:يُدْعَوْنَ}} ({{tr:yudʿawna}}), it forms a past habitual or continuing passive: they used to be called, not merely once invited. The plural ending carries the same judged group into that past frame, so the people whose eyes are lowered are the same people whose opportunity is being recalled. The broader {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) field of being and becoming is narrowed here to auxiliary framing; it does not introduce an independent existence-event, but characterizes their prior condition as people being called while sound. This tense pivot sets the vivid present of disgrace against accountable past opportunity, and the repeated past auxiliary also joins the surah's wider pattern of retrospective characterization before the final capacity indictment.

words.prose: {{ar:يُدْعَوْنَ}} ({{tr:yudʿawna}}) keeps them as recipients of a summons while leaving the caller unnamed. Under {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}), its imperfect passive form makes the calling habitual or continuing in the past. The root could move through call, prayer, invocation, naming, or claim, but {{ar:إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ}} ({{tr:ilā al-sujūdi}}) selects a directed summons toward an act, making the call answerable and binding rather than vague. That passive call plus directional goal plus prostration is a distinctive, hapax-like collocation in the supplied evidence. Across the boundary, the same passive call links the summons they cannot answer in the judgment scene (68:42) with the summons they received while sound here. The contrast with active {{ar:تَرْهَقُهُمْ}} ({{tr:tarhaquhum}}) matters too: in judgment they receive humiliation's action, while in life they had received an invitation requiring response.

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) makes {{ar:ٱلسُّجُودِ}} ({{tr:al-sujūdi}}) the goal of the passive call. The summons is directed toward prostration, not cast as a burden with another preposition, and not closed off as mere being-called. Because the preposition can carry direction, aim, and terminus, the phrase keeps both physical movement toward prostration and purposive movement toward submission in view. Across the boundary, the repeated {{ar:إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ}} ({{tr:ilā al-sujūdi}}) keeps the demanded goal identical; what changes is their capacity and temporal situation.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسُّجُودِ}} ({{tr:al-sujūdi}}) is definite and governed by {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}), so it names the known endpoint of the summons. Its maṣdar form selects the act of prostration itself, not a prostrating person or a place. The root can span bodily prostration and reverent submission, and the local wording keeps both because the concrete act embodies acknowledgment. Across the boundary, the same definite maṣdar is repeated: the prostration they cannot perform in the judgment scene (68:42) is the same prostration they had been called to while sound. This also creates the ayah's paired lowering: voluntary {{ar:ٱلسُّجُودِ}} ({{tr:al-sujūdi}}) was refused, and imposed {{ar:خَٰشِعَةً}} ({{tr:khāshiʿatan}}) now opens the scene.

words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) opens the circumstantial clause {{ar:هُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ}} ({{tr:hum sālimūna}}). It does not simply add another fact; it attaches their soundness to the time of being called. The connector plus explicit pronoun makes a compact nominal state-clause, so the final predicate can disclose the condition under which the summons occurred. This is the boundary reversal in miniature: they cannot prostrate now in the judgment scene (68:42), but they had been called while sound before.

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) is independent here, not a suffix. It supplies the subject of the closing nominal state-clause and gives the soundness predicate its own footing. The pronoun keeps the same referent continuous through lowered eyes, humiliation covering them, and the past call. By standing before {{ar:سَٰلِمُونَ}} ({{tr:sālimūna}}), it creates a brief grammatical pause so the final word lands as the decisive disclosure of prior capacity.

topics.headline: explicit subject of the state-clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing soundness claim given its own clause shape rather than hidden in a suffix.
topics.reason: The pronoun functions as the subject of the nominal circumstantial clause whose predicate follows.

topics.headline: same group through the whole reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one group through inability, humiliation, past summons, and prior soundness.
topics.reason: The boundary and cross-reference evidence identify the same referent across both ayahs and clauses.

topics.headline: pause before the capacity disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final predicate land as the clause's decisive disclosure of prior capacity.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun precedes the predicate and gives it final-position force.

words.gloss_range: sound, intact, unimpaired, or whole as a plural predicate describing their prior capacity at the time of summons
words.root_gloss_range: safety, soundness, wholeness, peace, submission, handing over, and other branches; local form selects intactness/soundness while submission-family pressure remains a contrast

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the pronoun whose predicate is soundness
the demanded prostration that their prior soundness made answerable

words.prose: {{ar:سَٰلِمُونَ}} ({{tr:sālimūna}}) closes the ayah on capacity rather than on punishment. As the nominative active-participle predicate of {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}), it describes the people themselves as sound or intact when they were being called, not their eyes and not an abstract condition detached from them. The plural agreement applies that intactness to the whole group, and the participial form presents it as an established state. The root's soundness branch is local, while the submission-family branch remains a narrowed contrast beside {{ar:ٱلسُّجُودِ}} ({{tr:al-sujūdi}}): they were sound, yet the called-for submission was refused. This only-here plural active-participle formulation makes physical soundness beside refused prostration especially pointed. This final word answers the inability scene (68:42) by showing that incapacity now is culpable because capacity existed before, and it echoes the surah's earlier contrast with submitters (68:35).

topics.headline: soundness predicated of the people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees soundness applied to the people themselves, not to their eyes or to a detached abstraction.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the active participle the predicate of the independent plural pronoun.

topics.headline: established sound capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that they possessed an intact capacity condition when the summons came.
topics.reason: The active participle in the nominal state-clause presents soundness as an established condition.

topics.headline: sound but not submitters
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the irony that the local word selects intact soundness while the wider root family can evoke submission beside the refused prostration.
topics.reason: Local grammar and sense select soundness/intactness; submission-family meanings survive only as contrast pressure near the call to prostration.

topics.headline: prior being characterized by soundness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior being-frame is completed by soundness as its characterizing state.
topics.reason: The contextual profile links the local soundness participle with the being-frame supplied by {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}).

topics.headline: distinctive formulation of sound refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the distinctive formulation of being physically sound while refusing the prostration summons.
topics.reason: The row flags the local active-participle plural as a distinctive usage, and nothing in the guardrail evidence contradicts that observation.

topics.headline: soundness contrasted with submitters
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can contrast physical soundness here with the surah's earlier submitting group (68:35), without replacing the local sense with submission.
topics.reason: The same-root contrast is meaningful, but the local participle still means sound/intact rather than submitter.

topics.headline: final word closes on wasted capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah close not on punishment itself but on the prior capacity that makes refusal culpable.
topics.reason: The word's final position and the ayah's opening lowered state create the reversal from capacity to abasement.

topics.headline: prior soundness answers present inability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees present inability in 68:42 answered by the proof that intact capacity had existed before.
topics.reason: The boundary evidence links inability to prostrate in the previous ayah with the closing disclosure of prior soundness here.

baseline_models.mechanism: The opening posture and the recalled summons form a bodily reversal. Humble lowering is already occurring in the eyes, and the prostration root independently carries a branch of steady lowered gaze; humiliation now forces an ocular analogue of the prostration that could formerly have been offered by the whole person.

activation_trace.role: Low humble submission includes lowered gaze and bodily bowing, joining the first clause to the requested posture.
Literal eyesight locates the compelled lowering in the organ that had been able to look.
Overwhelming coverage makes abasement the force imposing the present posture.
Abasement under overpowering distinguishes this lowering from freely chosen humility.
Steady lowered gaze and languid eyes supply the exact ocular form into which prostration is displaced.

changed_reading.before: Their eyes are downcast from shame after a missed summons to prostrate.
changed_reading.after: The missed prostration returns as an involuntary prostration of the eyes: the posture is achieved under humiliation rather than offered freely.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus roots preserve two non-equivalent ways of becoming low. One is gentle, voluntary yielding without disgrace; the other is abasement imposed by an overpowering burden. Former soundness made the first mode possible, while the present engulfing converts the same broad posture into the second.

activation_trace.role: Gentle yielding without humiliation supplies the voluntary mode that remained available earlier.
Abasement under overpowering supplies the coercive mode now covering them.
Coercive burdening provides the pressure that changes yielding into imposed humiliation.
Prostration spans humble lowering and voluntary or compelled submission, holding both modes in one bodily action.
Soundness and freedom from defect mark the earlier condition in which yielding need not have been forced.

changed_reading.before: They once could prostrate, but now they are humiliated.
changed_reading.after: The ayah contrasts voluntary yielding while intact with yielding extracted by overpowering pressure: a similar low posture carries opposite agency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ترهقهم ... وقد كانوا يدعون ... وهم سالمون
baseline_models.mechanism: Nearing, catching up, and pressure at an appointed time combine with explicit past predication. The verse can therefore be heard as a closed interval: call and capacity once coincided, then abasement caught up after that usable interval had passed.

activation_trace.role: Nearing and catching up turns humiliation into an arriving consequence rather than a static attribute.
Pressed time near an appointed rite supplies the sense of an opportunity reaching its limit.
Past temporal predication establishes the former state as a bounded condition.
A voiced summons supplies the opportunity that was present during the earlier interval.
Soundness supplies the capacity that once overlapped with the summons.

changed_reading.before: The past clause simply contrasts an earlier healthy state with present shame.
changed_reading.after: The clause records an expired affordance: humiliation catches them only after the finite window in which summons and capacity coincided.

baseline_models.mechanism: The sight root includes inner discernment, proof, and self-witness. With the eyes grammatically possessed by those whom humiliation overtakes, their lowered sight can register not only public shame but inward recognition that can no longer sustain a contrary account.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight, proof, and self-witness make the gaze an epistemic witness against its owner.
Lowered gaze gives inward recognition a visible bodily consequence.
Overwhelming coverage prevents the self-witness from remaining a detached perception.
Overpowered abasement turns recognition into a publicly legible verdict.

changed_reading.before: The lowered eyes merely display an emotion.
changed_reading.after: The eyes are also self-witnesses: inward recognition becomes bodily evidence that the owners cannot look past.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening pen and ordered writing, followed by the announced marking of a nose, make the face a surface on which judgment becomes readable. The focus then supplies eyes whose lowered posture and covering humiliation function like a completed public inscription rather than an inaccessible private feeling.

activation_trace.role: The sharpened writing implement supplies the instrument side of a legible-verdict mechanism.
An ordered written line supplies inscription as a durable public record.
The nose or snout locates the announced mark on the same face whose eyes later disclose humiliation.
The physical eyes provide the facial surface that makes the verdict visible.
Lowered gaze supplies the readable sign inscribed by posture rather than ink.

structural_cues: The branchless و س م occurrence at 68:16 word 1 supplies the act of marking only as a structural cue.
The sequence runs from pen and writing to a marked face and finally to eyes that visibly carry abasement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, a marking construction, the nose, and lowered eyes; I infer that facial posture becomes a readable verdict. A live alternative is a looser motif of public exposure without an inscription mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The eyes disclose an internal state of shame.
changed_reading.after: Their lowered eyes operate as the final line of a public verdict written onto the face by posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early promise that both sides will see is followed by an assay-like dispute and by knowledge as disclosure. When the focus finally names their eyes, sight is no longer a neutral faculty: the promised adjudication has landed in the organ itself, whose posture reveals the result.

activation_trace.role: Mutual future seeing establishes sight as the medium of a deferred disclosure.
Testing metal or a person supplies an assay whose result can later become visible.
Disclosure to the knower makes the future seeing an adjudicatory unveiling rather than mere observation.
Inner sight and self-witness allow the disclosed result to be recognized by those whose eyes bear it.
The lowered gaze embodies the outcome of the promised seeing.

structural_cues: The future pair in 68:5 leaves seeing unresolved, while 68:43 assigns a determinate posture specifically to their eyes.
The intervening contrast between error and guidance gives the visual disclosure a discriminating function.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deferred mutual seeing, testing, disclosed knowledge, and the final eye posture; I infer that 68:43 is one embodied landing of that verdict. The promised seeing could also extend beyond this single scene.

changed_reading.after: The eyes also carry the deferred verdict announced by 'you will see and they will see': seeing has become self-disclosing evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden moves from expected fruitfulness to a cut-off, ruined condition that its owners see and name as deprivation. That material sequence activates the low desolate-ground branch of خ ش ع: in the focus, their eyes themselves can image the razed landscape of a capacity that has been lost.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and separation supply the garden's abrupt transition from available yield to severed outcome.
Seeing with eye and insight makes recognition of the altered landscape part of the mechanism.
Deprivation and failure to obtain the intended good name the result perceived in the ruined ground.
Low desolate or dormant ground transfers the garden's ruined material profile into the downcast eyes.
The eyes are both the earlier instrument of recognizing loss and the later surface that images it.

structural_cues: The garden sequence turns overnight from planned harvest to sight, disorientation, and the explicit correction 'rather, we are deprived.'
The focus likewise juxtaposes a former viable condition with a present lowered state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a materially ruined garden, its visual recognition, deprivation, and a focus branch of desolate ground; I map the garden's state onto the eyes as an image. The live alternative is that the two scenes share only moral reversal, not material imagery.

changed_reading.before: Downcast eyes express humiliation after capacity is lost.
changed_reading.after: The eyes become a miniature ruined landscape: what happened to the expected garden now happens visually to former soundness and standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners answer their own morning call, lower their voices, proceed with exclusionary intent, and regard themselves as able. The focus's 'they had been called ... while sound' is thereby morally specified: capacity was not absent but selectively mobilized for concealment and exclusion rather than for prostration.

activation_trace.role: Raised calling supplies a summons that the group does answer when it serves its own plan.
Lowered secret speech shows controlled bodily and vocal agency used to conceal the plan.
Directed intent supplies the chosen goal toward which their capacity is organized.
Effective capability makes the earlier agency operational rather than merely theoretical.
The focus summons provides the call that did not receive the response given to their own call.
Soundness supplies the intact capacity whose selective use is exposed by the garden sequence.
The later lowered gaze reverses the earlier deliberate lowering of voices.

structural_cues: At 68:24 the whispered plan explicitly bars a poor person from entering, so the mobilized capacity has an exclusionary object.
At 68:26 the same group can still see and speak when its plan collapses; the focus later recalls a different unanswered summons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a self-issued call, covert coordination, intent, capability, and the focus's earlier summons; I infer a typological contrast in how agency is spent. The garden owners and the focus pronoun need not be numerically identical for the mechanism to operate.

changed_reading.before: Former soundness marks a neutral window of ability that later expired.
changed_reading.after: Former soundness is charged evidence of selectively exercised agency: call, coordination, and movement worked for exclusion, but not for the summons to prostrate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby contrast between muslimin and criminals activates the handover branch of the same root as salimun, while the next scene couples prostration with lost ability. Former soundness can thus be carried as an unspent means for active surrender, not only as bodily health.

activation_trace.role: Handing over and consigning activates active surrender within the root shared by muslimin and focus salimun.
Humble prostration supplies the concrete act in which surrender would be embodied.
Ability and capacity, now negated, define what earlier soundness had made usable.
Soundness anchors the reading in the focus word's direct condition of intactness.
The same-root handover branch supplies a latent purpose for that intactness without replacing the word's direct sense.

structural_cues: The sequence places muslimin at 68:35, inability to prostrate at 68:42, and former salimun at 68:43.
The contrast depends on morphology as well as root recurrence: muslimin and salimun are related but not interchangeable forms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a same-root contrast, handover, prostration, and lost ability; I infer that soundness was a means available for surrender. The live alternative, and safer direct gloss, is simple physical or functional capability.

changed_reading.before: They were physically sound when summoned.
changed_reading.after: Their soundness was also an unused affordance for self-handover: intactness could have become willing submission before ability closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Book, binding record, oath, judgment, questioning, and demanded guarantor form a chain of claim-testing. Against it, the focus call can activate the دعو branch of claiming a right, while inner sight supplies self-witness; the summons to prostrate becomes the act that exposes whether the asserted standing can be warranted.

activation_trace.role: A written fixing that imposes judgment supplies the binding record against which claims are tested.
The oath supplies a purported guarantee extending the claim into the judgment scene.
Judgment between parties gives the surrounding questions a forensic frame.
Questioning and demand initiate the explicit test of who can answer for the claim.
Suretyship or guarantee supplies the missing warrant the challengers are asked to produce.
Claiming a right or affiliation lets the focus summons function as a demand that tests asserted standing.
Inner sight, proof, and self-witness make the lowered eyes evidence within the claim-testing mechanism.
Public abasement supplies the enacted adverse result when no warrant can stand.

structural_cues: The repeated rhetorical questions from 68:36 through 68:41 demand a rule, book, oath, guarantor, or partners before the bodily test arrives.
The explicit horizon 'day of rising' at 68:39 links the claim-testing sequence to the scene immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies records, oaths, judgment, questioning, guarantee, and focus branches of claim and self-witness; I infer a juridical summons whose bodily response tests standing. The sequence may remain polemical rather than a formal courtroom procedure.

changed_reading.before: The call to prostrate is principally ritual and the eyes show shame.
changed_reading.after: The call is also a claim-testing summons: the failed bodily response and self-witnessing eyes publicly invalidate an asserted entitlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding scene removes a cover, exposes the leg or names acute readiness, repeats the summons to prostration, and negates ability. The focus then applies a new cover: humiliation overwhelms them while the eyes enact the lowered ocular branch of prostration. Disclosure is therefore an exchange of coverings and bodily agencies, not merely a revelation followed by emotion.

activation_trace.role: Removing a cover supplies the initial exposure that opens the judgment scene.
Uncovering the leg for severity or readiness localizes exposure in a body part poised for action.
The voiced summons is repeated almost verbatim by the focus's retrospective clause.
The prostration root's lowered-eye branch anticipates the exact posture named at the start of the focus.
Negated capacity closes the possibility of producing the demanded whole-body act.
Overwhelming coverage supplies the new cover of humiliation after concealment is removed.
The eyes become the body part that can still register the demanded lowering.
Overpowered abasement names the covering imposed after exposure.

structural_cues: 68:42 and 68:43 repeat يدعون إلى السجود, first with present inability and then with past soundness.
The sequence isolates leg, whole-body prostration, and eyes, distributing agency across body parts without changing the demanded act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies removal of cover, an exposed leg or severity idiom, repeated summons, inability, and engulfing abasement; I infer an exchange in which exposure is followed by a punitive cover. The leg phrase may remain idiomatic, but its readiness branch preserves the bodily contrast.

changed_reading.before: A hidden reality is revealed, they cannot prostrate, and then they feel shame.
changed_reading.after: Exposure strips one cover only for humiliation to become another; the incapable body fails while the eyes involuntarily complete the requested lowering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stepwise taking, extended time, concealed strategy, and durable tensile strength activate the catching and pressed-time branches of ترهقهم. Present humiliation becomes the arrival of a process that advanced by degrees during the interval in which they still appeared sound.

activation_trace.role: Taking degree by degree supplies the incremental motion hidden before the focus outcome.
Temporal extension and respite supply the apparent interval of continued safety.
Concealed strategy supplies direction to the otherwise unnoticed delay.
Extended solidity supplies the process's durable capacity to reach its end.
Nearing and catching up render humiliation as the endpoint that finally reaches them.
Pressed time converts the earlier period of soundness into expiring respite.
Past predication marks soundness as a former phase within the longer process.

structural_cues: The future first-person sequence at 68:44-45 explicitly joins unnoticed location, gradual movement, respite, strategy, and firmness.
The focus's وقد كانوا looks backward from a completed reversal and is compatible with that delayed process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies steps, delay, strategy, durability, and focus branches of catching and time-pressure; I infer that these describe the latent approach to the focus condition. The verses after the focus may instead assure a broader process rather than narrate its chronology.

changed_reading.before: Humiliation arrives as a punctual judgment after a past opportunity.
changed_reading.after: Humiliation is the moment an already advancing, deliberately prolonged process catches up; apparent soundness belonged inside the delay.

context_deltas.mechanism: One figure calls while choked, and grace catches him before casting into exposed blame; in the focus, others had been called while sound, but humiliation catches them. The two call-and-catch chains cross: distress does not prevent responsive calling, and soundness does not guarantee responsive yielding.

activation_trace.role: Raised calling supplies a response issued from within constriction, reversing the focus's unanswered call during soundness.
Holding breath and silence supply the constrained condition from which the call nevertheless emerges.
Beneficent grace supplies the force that interrupts the movement toward exposed blame.
Catching up supplies a beneficent counterpart to humiliation's catching movement in the focus.
Casting away supplies the consequence that grace prevents before it becomes final.
Open uncovered space gives the threatened disgrace a spatial form of exposure.
Blame supplies the near outcome intercepted by grace and comparable to the focus's abasement.
The earlier summons while sound supplies the unanswered side of the crossed call pattern.
Humiliation's nearing and catching supplies the adverse catch not intercepted in the focus.
Soundness sharpens the asymmetry: favorable condition did not produce the response that constriction did elsewhere.

structural_cues: The conditional at 68:49 explicitly holds together an approaching rescue and a counterfactual sequence of casting, exposure, and blame.
The call from constriction at 68:48 follows the focus's recollection of a summons made during soundness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two calls, two catching roots, opposed conditions, and opposed outcomes; I infer a counterfactual mechanism in which grace can intercept disgrace. The figures remain distinct, so this is a relational contrast rather than identity or automatic soteriology.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives a closed sequence from missed opportunity to overtaking humiliation.
changed_reading.after: A neighboring counter-sequence remains visible: grace can catch before disgrace does, while calling under constriction exposes the squandered privilege of being called while sound.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later hostile gaze nearly dislodges another from his station after its owners hear the reminder. Set against the focus, visual agency reverses: eyes that function like a projectile or destabilizing surface become lowered organs whose own possessors are covered by abasement. Their covering of truth also reverses into being covered.

activation_trace.role: Near-performance holds the hostile visual act at the edge of taking effect.
Covering truth supplies the agents' active covering, later reversed by humiliation covering them.
Dislodging a thing from its station on an unstable surface gives the hostile gaze kinetic force.
Physical eyes are the apparent instrument aimed at destabilizing another.
Understanding and compliance, activated but not realized by hearing, connect the hostile response to the earlier unanswered summons.
A reminder that actively recalls supplies what the hearing should have converted into response.
The same visual organ is now possessed, lowered, and deprived of its former outward aggression.
Low humble gaze supplies the reversal of visual elevation and attack.
Overwhelming coverage reverses the agents' own covering of truth into a condition imposed on them.

structural_cues: Both scenes make eyes grammatically belong to the opposed collective, but one directs them outward and the other lowers them inward.
Because 68:51 follows the focus in packet order, the relation is thematic and reversible rather than assumed to be simple chronology.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-action, dislodging, hostile eyes, hearing, reminder, and humbled eyes; I infer a reversal from weaponized sight to defeated sight and from covering to being covered. The same collective is strongly suggested by discourse but not proved by branch data alone.

changed_reading.before: Their eyes are passive indicators of humiliation.
changed_reading.after: The lowered eyes are the reversal of previously weaponized sight: the organ aimed at dislodging another can no longer maintain its own elevation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant mapped root د ع ع beneath the focus occurrence of د ع و, and its forceful-driving image must not replace the direct sense of a summons. It remains anchored to the exact focus root mapping and coheres with coercive burdening and compelled lowering; downstream prose should call it a kinetic undertone or branch activation, never a lexical translation.

activation_trace.role: The split-root branch of rough thrusting or forceful driving adds a latent shove beneath the ordinary voiced summons.
The cry telling a stumbler to rise adds an ironic upward command inside a scene whose demanded act is downward.
Coercive burdening keeps the forceful undertone functionally connected to the imposed present posture.
Compelled or voluntary lowering supplies the bodily destination toward which the latent drive points.

changed_reading.before: The call is purely invitational and coercion begins only with later humiliation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the summons carries a buried shove and a cry to rise, making force and bodily reversal audible inside the call itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the snakebitten person called 'sound' is an ironic lexical branch, not the ordinary predication of سالمون. It remains anchored to that exact focus root and gains mechanism from gradual taking and respite; downstream prose should present it only as a diagnostic analogy for apparent intactness during latent injury, not as the verse's direct gloss.

activation_trace.role: The snakebitten person called sound supplies ironic intactness that may conceal an injury already received.
Catching up lets the concealed injury analogy mature into the later overtaking condition.
Degree-by-degree movement supplies the latent advance hidden beneath apparent soundness.
Extended respite supplies the interval in which hidden damage and a label of soundness can coexist.

changed_reading.before: Soundness is simply the absence of impairment at the time of the call.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, 'sound' can name apparent intactness while an unnoticed process is already advancing toward visible humiliation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates lexicalized prostration branches involving image-coins and tribute, then links them to the nearby burden of financial liability. The reading remains anchored to السجود and to the focus's coercive burden and abasement, but it is a political-economic analogy rather than a proposed ritual gloss; downstream prose should qualify it explicitly as branch-distant.

activation_trace.role: Image-coins before which submission is made supply a material sign of authority and compelled recognition.
Lexicalized tribute supplies an economic form of subordinating acknowledgment.
Coercive burdening connects ritual refusal to an exploratory model of imposed liability.
Abasement under power supplies the social relation enacted by forced tribute.
A binding financial liability activates the economic consequence side of the analogy.
The loading of a burden makes liability bodily oppressive rather than merely notional.

changed_reading.before: The missed prostration is exclusively a refused ritual posture.
changed_reading.after: Branch-distantly, refusal of willing acknowledgment can return as imposed tribute-like liability: submission is extracted as burden and public abasement.

strongest_changes: The requested whole-body prostration reappears involuntarily as prostration of the eyes under an engulfing cover of abasement.
The garden sequence specifies former soundness as capacity selectively spent on covert exclusion, not neutral ability left unused.
The adjacent scene exchanges coverings and body-part agency: concealment is removed, whole-body capacity fails, and the eyes perform the lowering.
Stepwise delay makes humiliation a process catching up, while the nearby grace narrative preserves an opposed catch that can intercept exposed blame.
The hostile gaze of 68:51 reverses into the humbled gaze of the focus, turning outward visual force into inward self-witness.
summary.what_was_special: The packet sustained several mechanisms at once: bodily displacement, temporal expiry, public inscription, material ruin, juridical testing, crossed call-and-catch sequences, and reversal of visual force. Split and lexicalized branches were retained only with explicit containment rather than flattened into direct glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: The garden owners and the collective in the focus support a strong typological echo, but the packet alone does not prove numerical identity.
The same-root movement from salimun to muslimin is morphologically suggestive but must not erase the distinct forms or the direct sense of soundness.
The relation between the focus and 68:51 is thematic and reversible; verse order does not by itself establish a simple earlier-to-later chronology.
Non-dominant and lexicalized branches can diagnose latent structure, but prose should keep them exploratory and avoid presenting them as translations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Eyes lowered under an overwhelming cover.** `خ ش ع B001` supplies lowered humble submission, `ب ص ر B001` sight, `ر ه ق B001` overwhelming cover, and `ذ ل ل B001` abasement under power. The fronted circumstantial adjective locates submission in their eyes before disgrace is said to cover them. I infer previously adversarial sight is forced downward by disclosed reality; the ayah reverses the confident seeing promised in 68:5 and the weaponized gaze of 68:51.
2. **Coerced abasement versus prior willing soundness.** `ذ ل ل B002` allows gentle voluntary yielding, `د ع و B001` calling, `س ج د B001` submission, `ك و ن B001` prior state, and `س ل م B001` soundness/safety. The *wa-qad* clause contrasts current inability with an earlier intact condition. I infer unused capacity hardens into compelled posture; the ayah distinguishes voluntary humility from humiliating overpowering.
3. **A burden that catches up.** `ر ه ق B002/B003` supplies nearing/catching and coercive burdening. Their past calls recur at the present scene as a consequence that overtakes them. I infer deferred response does not erase the summons but lets its unfulfilled demand catch up as burden; *tarhaquhum* becomes temporally as well as spatially oppressive.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:51 gives the eyes a startling earlier social posture: before being lowered, hostile eyes nearly make the addressee slip. 68:52 identifies the reminder as the universal call they had heard, sharpening the contrast between auditory access, bodily soundness, and refused submission.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The gaze performs the lowering the body withheld.** Fixed `خَاشِعَة` activates `خ ش ع B001` (low humble submission), fixed `أَبْصَار` activates `ب ص ر B001` (the faculty and organ of sight), and fixed `ٱلسُّجُود` activates `س ج د B005` (steady lowered gaze). The failed bodily capacity in 68:42 supplies the displacement; I infer that submission migrates to the eyes as an involuntary visible mark. The ayah reads as a fragmented prostration whose optical part survives without willing wholeness.
2. **Humiliation catches up with refused gentle yielding.** Fixed `تَرْهَقُهُمْ` activates `ر ه ق B002` (nearing and catching up), while fixed `ذِلَّة` activates `ذ ل ل B001` (abasement under overpowering) and the contrasted branch `ذ ل ل B002` (gentle yielding without humiliation). Fixed `سَالِمُون` supplies prior soundness through `س ل م B001`; I infer the arrow refused voluntary yielding while sound → later coerced abasement overtakes them. Humiliation is read as delayed consequence, not a synonym for the earlier invitation.
3. **Soundness was usable capacity, not guaranteed status.** Fixed `سَالِمُون` activates `س ل م B001` (freedom from harm or defect). The earlier ability implied by soundness and present inability supply a temporal contrast; I infer that intact faculties were an opportunity whose nonuse did not preserve them. “Sound” describes a prior actionable condition rather than permanent safety.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:48's command to disciplined patience supplied a later image of voluntary restraint under judgment. It sharpened the contrast inside fixed `ذِلَّة`: gentle willing yielding (`ذ ل ل B002`) had been available, whereas overpowering abasement (`ذ ل ل B001`) now catches up.

baseline.text: Bakışları yere eğilmiş, onları aşağılanma kaplamış olacaktır. Oysa sapasağlamken secdeye çağrılıyorlardı.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] The Body Must Be Able to Stand, Bend, and Obey
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Submission is a bodily capacity expressed through posture, jointed movement, lowered profile, and response to command.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Failure to prostrate is rendered as a breakdown across posture, limb, gaze, footing, tractability, and jointed capacity, not simply unwillingness at the final moment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Low Ground, Spent Hump, and Hanging Edge Materialize Humbling
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A proud profile loses height like low ground, a setting star, or a depleted camel hump, while the body and garment hang downward.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: bowed humility (`quranic:root_000412:B001/m01`); low lifeless terrain (`quranic:root_000412:B002/m01`); sinking star (`quranic:root_000412:B003/m01`); hump with its crest depleted (`quranic:root_000412:B004/m01`); abasement under force (`quranic:root_000519:B001/m01`); gentle lowliness (`quranic:root_000519:B002/m01`); hanging lower edge (`quranic:root_000519:B005/m01`); struck peg (`quranic:root_000519:B006/m01`); head-and-chest lowering (`quranic:root_001307:B014/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Humbling is a loss of vertical prominence. Terrain, star, hump, garment edge, head, and chest all descend by different mechanisms, giving the verse’s lowered eyes and covering humiliation a coherent shape.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Tractability and Ability Can Fail Before the Command
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A subject may obey, become capable through effort, or be internally eased toward action; fatigue, damaged limbs, or lost sight can instead arrest performance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: willing obedience (`quranic:root_000956:B001/m02`); capacity to act (`quranic:root_000956:B003/m01`); effortful acquisition of capacity (`quranic:root_000956:B004/m01`); self-facilitation (`quranic:root_000956:B006/m02`); immobility and exhaustion (`quranic:root_001273:B016/m01`); leg disease preventing stance (`quranic:root_001273:B020/m01`); intact eye without sight (`quranic:root_001273:B021/m01`); sound bodily condition (`quranic:root_000737:B001/m02`); power or ability (`quranic:root_000076:B011/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:39 `قِيَٰمَةِ` [ق و م]; 68:42 `يَسْتَطِيعُ` [ط و ع]; 68:43 `سَٰلِمُونَ` [س ل م]; surface anchor unavailable for root `ء ل ي`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Inability can arise at several levels: no power, no acquired skill, no inner facilitation, exhausted stance, damaged leg, or failed sight. The branches keep these operational failures distinct from refusal.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Perception Can Stabilize Knowledge or Strip Away Footing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Sensory contact becomes reliable only when eye, ear, inward understanding, and stable bodily position cooperate.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Hostile looking is rendered as a literal destabilization of ground and skin, while hearing can progress to understanding or become weighted, bound, and merely reputational.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Sight Becomes Insight by Reading Marks
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The eye registers a surface, inward sight interprets it, blood-trace or stone supplies visible evidence, and a remembered mark guides cognition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ocular sight (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m02`); inward discernment (`quranic:root_000121:B002/m02`); visible blood trace (`quranic:root_000121:B004/m01`); pale gleaming stone (`quranic:root_000121:B007/m02`); knowledge as disclosure (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m03`); identifying landmark (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m02`); retained remembrance (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); reminder restoring presence (`quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Sight supplies data, not completion. Trace and landmark make the surface readable; remembrance preserves the evidence; inward discernment converts it into knowledge. This sequence contrasts with the hostile gaze that seeks effect without understanding.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Hostile looking dislodges the target from a stable place as though the ground, animal body, or oiled skin had become too smooth to grip.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: slick barren surface that defeats footing (`quranic:root_000640:B001/m01`); slick animal hindquarter (`quranic:root_000640:B004/m01`); fast gliding camel (`quranic:root_000640:B006/m01`); oiled shining skin (`quranic:root_000640:B007/m01`); shaved smooth head (`quranic:root_000640:B008/m01`); hostile ocular act (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m03`); covering that blocks secure perception (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`).

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Madness Charge Confuses Hidden Mind with Covered Truth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Observers encounter an inaccessible interior, cover the truth, and replace inquiry with an accusation that attributes corruption or derangement to the speaker.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sensory concealment (`quranic:root_000266:B001/m03`); mind covered by madness (`quranic:root_000266:B006/m02`); hidden heart (`quranic:root_000266:B010/m02`); overpowering affliction (`quranic:root_000606:B001/m01`); attributed corruption and falsehood (`quranic:root_000606:B005/m01`); denial covering truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); assigning unbelief to another (`quranic:root_001307:B006/m01`); false attribution in speech (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:43 `تَرْهَقُ` [ر ه ق]; 68:51 `كَفَرُ` [ك ف ر], `يَقُولُ` [ق و ل], and `مَجْنُونٌ` [ج ن ن].
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The accusation mistakes epistemic cover for diagnosed interior state. Concealment, denial, attribution, and overpowering affliction are different operations; their separation exposes how polemical naming substitutes for knowledge.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Covering Establishes the Stakes of Disclosure and Exposure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A cover creates an interior that may protect, hide, or entomb; lifting or losing it changes the occupant’s vulnerability and public status.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Unseen knowledge, armor, grave, grove, fruit-husk, uncovered defect, open hostility, exposed terrace, and abandoned child occupy distinct positions in one cover-removal mechanism.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Shield and Armor Preserve an Interior Under Attack
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A fitted shield, armor, or covering layer absorbs exterior force while keeping the enclosed body sound.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: protective barrier (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m02`); shield (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m04`); armor (`quranic:root_000121:B005/m03`); defensive weapon or mail (`quranic:root_000633:B005/m01`); covering layer (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m02`); wounded person named “sound” in hope or surrender (`quranic:root_000737:B009/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This is protective concealment rather than epistemic evasion. The cover remains fitted to a vulnerable body and is judged by whether soundness survives the blow.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Extended time can be organized into incremental approach, deception, pursuit, and eventual arrival at a fixed limit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Delay is not inactivity. Dictation, head-start, slow-kindling fire, stepwise luring, long pursuit, and final overtaking describe how time itself becomes an instrument.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Approach Ends in Overtaking at the Limit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A pursuer draws near, urgency narrows the remaining time, and arrival or catch reaches the target before it passes beyond recovery.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: following until near capture (`quranic:root_000606:B002/m01`); deadline pressure (`quranic:root_000606:B004/m01`); catching and reaching (`quranic:root_000471:B001/m01`); liability that catches up (`quranic:root_000471:B004/m01`); arrival (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); road and endpoint (`quranic:root_000009:B010/m01`); calamity arriving (`quranic:root_000009:B011/m01`); penetrating efficacy (`quranic:root_000009:B013/m01`); reaching a limit (`quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`); severe condition reaching its height (`quranic:root_000151:B008/m01`); final calamity (`quranic:root_000151:B011/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Arrival can save or destroy depending on what arrives first. The same pursuit geometry holds divine favor that overtakes the fish-companion before exposure and liability or calamity that catches the uncorrected actor.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Joined Parts Create Load-Bearing and Water-Handling Systems
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Cutting, joining, tying, and fitting convert separate materials into containers, conduits, rigging, and frames that can carry load or govern flow.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Stitched hide, tanning bark, sandal strap, bucket handle, well-rope splice, underground channel, body joint, shin, and tool-leg share an engineering logic of fitted parts under tension.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Stitched and Tensioned Hide Becomes a Working Container
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Hide is tanned, edged, stitched to another panel, treated, and held under tension until it can function as a vessel, tent panel, or fitted strap.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: joining and stitching (`quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`); joining hide or cloth panels at a thick edge (`quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`); tanning tree and bark (`quranic:root_000737:B008/m01`); sandal strap and its repair (`quranic:root_000791:B004/m01`); hide or tent tensioned by thongs (`quranic:root_001396:B008/m01`); thick syrup used to dress or repair a skin vessel (`quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The container is not a natural whole. Plant material prepares the hide, edge thickness permits a seam, stitch and strap join the parts, and tension gives the assembly usable form; treatment then preserves the skin as a vessel rather than leaving it raw material.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rope, Handle, Basin, and Channel Complete a Water Circuit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A rope is lengthened to reach water, attached to a handled bucket, raised over a well-edge, and emptied into a basin or managed conduit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: well-rope splice and ring (`quranic:root_000471:B003/m01`); single-handled water-carrier's bucket (`quranic:root_000737:B011/m01`); bucket handle or balancing crosspiece (`quranic:root_000741:B008/m01`); linked wells or openings that preserve water flow (`quranic:root_001303:B005/m01`); binding loop that joins cord ends (`quranic:root_001303:B006/m01`); collected basin-water (`quranic:root_000220:B002/m01`); excavated rim around well or basin (`quranic:root_000220:B003/m01`); directed watercourse (`quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`); water-rich well or sea (`quranic:root_001040:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Each component answers a different hydraulic problem: depth requires a splice, weight a handle, lifting a balanced attachment, collection a basin, and distribution a controlled channel. The scene is a complete flow system assembled from small lexical parts.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Body and Implement Share a Supporting Frame
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Back muscles, bones, joints, shin, and bodily mass bear weight in the same structural positions as an upright tool-part or standing support.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: back muscles flanking the spine (`quranic:root_001396:B003/m01`); finger, foot, and hoof bones and joints (`quranic:root_000737:B010/m01`); shin or load-bearing plant stem (`quranic:root_000762:B003/m01`); bodily mass and frame (`quranic:root_000239:B007/m01`); upright part of pulley, sword, bed, table, animal, or plough (`quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`); burden borne in the body (`quranic:root_000202:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Anatomy and implement are analogized by load path rather than appearance alone. Jointed bones articulate, the shin stands, back musculature stabilizes, and an upright fitted part transfers force through a tool or frame.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Ground Surface Controls Posture, Footing, and Exposure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Surface composition and elevation determine whether a body can stand, lower itself, move securely, find cover, or remain publicly exposed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Hard and soft stone, low dead earth, bare expanse, slick soil, hoof-protecting gait, mountain-center, hidden grove, floor cushion, and parapetless roof make bodily posture a property of terrain and shelter.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hardness and Elevation Establish a Bearing Surface
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Stone and elevated ground provide differing degrees of hardness, levelness, and support beneath a standing or prostrating body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hard stone mass (`quranic:root_000737:B007/m01`); soft or pale gleaming stone (`quranic:root_000121:B007/m02`); hard gravel ground (`quranic:root_000840:B005/m01`); mountain and central massif (`quranic:root_000840:B017/m01`); high hard ground (`quranic:root_001396:B002/m01`); solid and level object (`quranic:root_000852:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: A bearing surface is defined by how it receives weight. Soft stone yields, gravel resists, a level solid permits stable placement, and mountain or raised hard ground extends support to landscape scale.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Low, Bare, or Slick Ground Changes the Body's Gait
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A body lowers itself toward lifeless ground, crosses an uncovered surface, or adjusts its gait when smoothness and roughness threaten secure footing.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: low lifeless terrain (`quranic:root_000412:B002/m01`); uncovered open ground (`quranic:root_001005:B004/m01`); slick barren surface that defeats footing (`quranic:root_000640:B001/m01`); animal guarding a sore hoof from rough ground (`quranic:root_001677:B003/m01`); walking and proceeding along a route (`quranic:root_000468:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Posture responds to substrate. Lowness invites or figures lowering, exposure removes protective margins, slickness defeats traction, and painful roughness makes even a capable animal place each step defensively.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu tanıklık, insanın başını, bedenini ya da bakışını aşağı indirerek boyun eğmesini temel alır; bu durum sesin durulmasına ve içteki yakarışın organlara yansımasına da uzanır. Verilen çerçeve bu bedensel, davranışsal ve sessel görünümleri aynı alçalma ve boyun eğme çekirdeğinde doğru biçimde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, insanın boyun eğen ve sakinleşen durumuyla sınırlıdır; arazi, gök cisimleri, deve hörgücü ve göğüsten salgı çıkarma anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimler genel boyun eğme ve alçalma durumunu verir; bakışın indirilmesi, seslerin dinmesi ve organların etkilenmesi yalnız kendi yapıları içinde yorumlanır.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin boyun eğerek başını, bedenini veya bakışını aşağı indirmesi ve dingin bir tutum almasıdır. Bu iç yöneliş, belirli yapılarda sesin alçalması ya da organların sakinleşmiş duruşuyla görünür olur.

facets.statement: Kişi kendini alçaltan bir tutumla boyun eğer ve dinginleşir.
Başın, göğsün veya bakışın aşağı indirilmesi bu tutumun bedensel görünümüdür.
Seslere uygulandığında seslerin kesilmesini, durulmasını ve alçalmasını bildirir.
İçteki yakarış ve boyun eğiş, organların sakin ve alçalmış duruşunda dışa vurabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar alçalma, boyun eğme ve dinginlik çekirdeğinde birleşir; baş, göğüs, bakış, ses ve organlar bu çekirdeğin farklı görünüm alanlarıdır. Kimi kullanımlarda eğilerek durma, kimi kullanımlarda ise böyle görünmeye çalışma ayrıca belirtilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili tanıklık yalnız cansız ve kuru toprağı değil, yere yakın bir arazi parçasını veya küçük yükseltiyi; ayrıca yapıya bağlı olarak tozlu yöreyi, kurumuş toprağı ve çöküp yere yaklaşan duvarı kapsar. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak onu yalnızca alçak ve cansız arazi diye sunan görüntü daha geniş ve katmanlı bir tanımla düzeltilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yere yakın arazi adı dalın yalın çekirdeğidir; kuruluk, tozluluk ve duvarın çökmesi yalnız ilgili adlarla kurulan yapılara aittir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad, yere yakın arazi parçasını veya küçük yükseltiyi belirtir; yöre, toprak ve duvarla kurulan kullanımların tozluluk, kuruluk ve çökme anlamları bu ada genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yalın kullanımda yere yakın duran bir arazi parçasını, sırtı veya küçük yükseltiyi belirtir; tanıklıklar yüzeyin düzleşmiş ya da pürüzlü oluşunda ayrışır. Belirli yapılarda bu alçalma görüntüsü tozlu ve yerleşimsiz yöreye, kuruyup cansızlaşmış toprağa veya çökerek yerle bir olan duvara uygulanır.

facets.statement: Yere yakın duran arazi parçası, sırt veya küçük yükselti yalın adın çekirdeğidir.
Arazi parçası kimi tanıklıkta düzleşmiş ve kolay geçilir, kiminde pürüzlü olarak betimlenir.
Yöre veya yer için kullanıldığında tozlu ve yerleşimsiz olmayı bildirir.
Toprak için kullanıldığında yağmursuz kalıp kurumuş, bitkisiz ve cansız duruma gelmeyi bildirir.
Duvar için kullanıldığında çöküp yüksekliğini yitirerek yer düzeyine inmeyi bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yere yakınlık ve alçalmış görünüm çevresinde birleşir. Bunun yanında arazi parçasının düz ya da pürüzlü oluşunda ayrışır; tozlu ve boş yöre, yağmursuz kalmış bitkisiz toprak ve çökmüş duvar kullanımları da aynı toplu iddiada yer alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Doğrudan arazi biçimi veya bitkisizlik kesişimi bulunan üç aday seçildi. Yüksek arazi, verimli çukur, dağlara giriş ve kumluk gibi öteki alan kartları yalnız aynı çevreyi paylaşır; insan, gök cismi ve hörgüç dallarıysa fiziksel alçalma imgesine rağmen ayrı çekirdeklere sahiptir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tanıklık iki göksel yapıyı birlikte verir: güneş söz konusu olduğunda tutulma veya kararma, yıldızlar söz konusu olduğunda ufka inip gözden kaybolmaya yaklaşma. Yıldızın batışını öne çıkaran dal görüntüsü kullanılabilir, ancak güneş tutulmasını aynı olaymış gibi göstermemek için iki yapı açıkça ayrılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnız verilen güneş ve yıldız yapılarında geçerlidir; genel bir kararma, düşme veya batma anlamı olarak genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız güneşin tutulmasını ve yıldızların ufka inmesini bildiren iki göksel yapıyla sınırlıdır; bunlardan yalın bir kök anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yalnız gök cisimleriyle kurulan yapılarda, güneşin tutulup kararmasını veya yıldızların ufka inerek gözden kaybolmaya yaklaşmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Gök cisminin görünürlüğü ya kararma ya da ufka iniş yoluyla azalır.
Güneşle kurulan yapıda tutulma, kararma ve görünürlüğün azalması anlatılır.
Yıldızlarla kurulan yapıda ufka iniş ve batmaya yaklaşma anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dalın bütün verisi tek bir tanıklık kümesinde iki ayrı göksel yapıya ayrılır; güneş için tutulma, yıldızlar için ufka yaklaşarak gözden kaybolma bildirilir.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, güneş için tutulmayı; yıldızlar için ufka yaklaşarak gözden kaybolmayı bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız güneş tutulması ile yıldızların ufka inişini birlikte kapsayan üst anlatım olarak kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Her iki yapıda da görünürlüğün azalması ve kaybolmaya yaklaşma sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Güneşin tutulduğu veya bu olayda kararıp görünürlüğünün azaldığı yapı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güneşin tutulması ve kararması olayını açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yıldızların ufka inip gözden kaybolmaya yaklaştığı yapı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yıldızların ufka inişini ve batmaya yaklaşmasını korur.
Yıldızların ufka inip gözden kaybolması yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Güneşin ufka iniş olmadan tutulup kararması anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

error_profile.preserves: Işığın görünürlükten çekilmesi sonucunu kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Güneş tutulması ile yıldızın ufka inişi arasındaki iki ayrı süreci siler.
error_profile.adds: Işık kaynağının bütünüyle çalışmaz duruma geldiği izlenimini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Ateşin veya yapay bir ışığın sönmesiyle karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal güneşin görünürlüğünün azalabildiği bir durumu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda güneşin görünürlüğü tutulma nedeniyle azalır; ayrıca yıldızların ufka inişi de bu dala bağlıdır. Komşu dal ise güneşin ufukta batıp kaybolmasını merkez alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Güneş tutulması ve yıldızların batmaya yaklaşmasıyla sınırlı iki yapı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir şeyin yokluğa çekilmesini ve çeşitli ışıklı gök cisimlerinin batışını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yapıya bağlı kaybolma / genel gözden yitme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da güneş veya yıldızın görünmez duruma gelmesini anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız iki belirli göksel yapıda tutulma veya ufka iniş bildirir. Komşu dalın çekirdeği daha genel gözden yitme ve batmadır; bu yüzden gök dışındaki varlıklara da uzanabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Güneş tutulmasını veya yıldızların ufka inmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ayın evre sonunda ışığının giderek azalmasıyla görünmezleşmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: tutulma ya da batış / ayın küçülerek görünmezleşmesi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal göksel bir ışığın görünürlüğünün azalması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın süreçleri güneş tutulması ve yıldızların ufka hareketidir. Komşu dal ise ayın aylık evresinde ışıklı bölümünün küçülmesini anlatır; ortak sonuç benzer olsa da süreç ve gök cismi farklıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Görünmezleşme sonucunu taşıyıp süreç farkını açıklayan üç aday seçildi. Doğuş, ateş ışığı, gezegenlerin geri hareketi ve güneşin gökteki başka konum değişimleri farklı çekirdeklere sahipti; kardeş dallar ise yalnız alçalma imgesi üzerinden uzaktan bağlantılıydı.

source_note.TA: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, güneş için tutulmayı; yıldızlar için ufka yaklaşarak gözden kaybolmayı bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tanıklıklar devenin hörgücündeki yağın tükenmesini, geriye çok az bölüm kalmasını ve tepenin aşağı çökmesini birlikte bildirir. Verilen dal görüntüsü hem süreci hem de ortaya çıkan biçim değişikliğini doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız devenin hörgücüyle kurulan yapıya aittir; genel zayıflama, kesme veya yüksekliğini yitirme anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız devenin hörgücündeki yağ kaybını ve buna bağlı çökmeyi bildiren yapıyla sınırlıdır; yalın bir zayıflama anlamı kurulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Devenin hörgücünün yağını yitirip büyük ölçüde erimesi ve tepesinin aşağı çökmesidir.

facets.statement: Devenin hörgücündeki yağ tükenir ve hörgüçten yalnız az bir bölüm kalır.
Yağ kaybının sonucu olarak hörgücün tepesi belirginliğini yitirip aşağı çöker.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar hörgücün büyük ölçüde erimesinde birleşir; daha ayrıntılı anlatım yağın tükenmesini ve hörgüç tepesinin aşağı çökmesini aynı sürecin aşamaları olarak açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Devenin hörgücündeki yağ kaybını ve bunun sonucundaki biçim değişikliğini birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yağın tükenmesi ile tepenin aşağı çökmesi arasındaki süreci korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir devenin hörgücü yağını yitirip geriye çok azı kaldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hörgücün erimesini ve aşağı çökmesini birlikte korur.
Yağ kaybı ve küçülme yönünü genel olarak korur.
error_profile.loses: Deve hörgücünün tepesinin çökmesi sonucunu açıkça göstermez.
error_profile.adds: Bütün bedenin veya herhangi bir varlığın güç ve ağırlık kaybetmesi anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Hayvanın genel olarak zayıflamasıyla karışır.

error_profile.preserves: Hörgüç tepesinin aşağı yönelmesi sonucunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hayvanın veya bedenin genel olarak yağını ve dolgunluğunu yitirmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda yağ kaybı görünür bir küçülmeye yol açar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız deve hörgücünün yağını yitirip çökmesini bildirir. Komşu dal bütün bedenin zayıflamasını merkez alır; hörgücün özel biçim değişikliğini gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hörgücün yağını yitirerek küçülmesini ve aşağı çökmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Devenin etle dolmasını ve bedenin ya da hörgücün dolgunlaşmasını bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal dolgunluğun kaybı ve çökmeyle sonuçlanan eksilme kutbundadır. Komşu dal ise etle dolma ve sıkılaşma kutbundadır; kapsamları tam örtüşmese de aynı doluluk ekseninde karşı karşıya gelirler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hörgüç kendiliğinden yağını yitirir ve tepesi çöker.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hörgücün bir parçasının dışarıdan kesilmesini veya kesilmiş parçayı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal aynı beden bölümündeki küçülme veya eksilmeyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal besisel tükenme sonucu oluşan erime ve çökmeyi anlatır. Komşu dalın çekirdeği dışarıdan yapılan kesme işlemidir; ortak beden bölümü, işlemleri eş anlamlı kılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Yağ kaybı, karşıt dolgunluk ve aynı beden bölümündeki kesme işlemini ayıran üç aday seçildi. Yükseklik, hörgücün anatomik adı, kemik iliği ve hayvan besleme kartları aynı alanı paylaşsa da doğrudan anlam karışıklığı yaratmıyordu; kardeş dallar farklı varlık ve süreçlere bağlıydı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tanıklıklar kişinin göğsünden gelen yapışkan bir salgıyı çıkarıp dışarı atması üzerinde birleşir. Bir aktarım, fiilin bu yapıda nesne alan ve başka yerde duyulmamış bir kullanım olduğunu ayrıca belirtir; bu kayıt dalın bağımsız bir genel anlam değil, sınırlı bir söz öbeği olduğunu doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız göğüsten gelen yapışkan salgının çıkarılmasını bildiren eski söz öbeğine aittir; genel tükürme, öksürme veya kusma anlamı taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız göğüsten gelen yapışkan salgıyı dışarı atmayı bildiren söz öbeğiyle sınırlıdır; fiile yalın bir çıkarma veya tükürme anlamı verilmez.

Çıkarılan göğüs salgısının yapışkan olduğu özellikle belirtilir.
Bir aktarım, kullanımı nesne alan ve başka yerde işitilmemiş sınırlı bir yapı olarak kaydeder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar göğüsten yapışkan bir salgı çıkarıp atma anlamında birleşir. Toplu iddia ayrıca fiilin nesne aldığı ve kullanımın seyrek ya da belirli bir aktarımla sınırlı görüldüğü yönünde bir dil bilgisi kaydı içerir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gözle görmeyi, görme duyusunu, bakan organı, kör olmayan kişiyi, dikkatle bakışı ve yavrunun gözünün açılıp görmeye hazır hale gelmesini birlikte verir. Bu yüzden dalın ana kimliği bedensel görme alanıdır; kalp bilgisi veya delil anlamları bu dala taşınmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Duyusal göz ve görme eylemiyle sınırlıdır; iç kavrayış ve kan, silah, taş ya da dikiş anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak görme duyusunu temel alır, fakat dikkatle bakma ve yavrunun göz açması gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımları ayrı bağlı uzantılar olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Gözle görme alanı: görme duyusu, bakan göz organı, bir şeyi gözle görmek ve gözün görmeye açılması. Dikkatle dikilerek bakma veya yavrunun gözünün açılması gibi kullanımlar bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: Görme duyusu, bakan göz organı ve bir şeyi gözle görme eylemi çekirdeği oluşturur.
Görme yetisine sahip kişi kör olanın karşıtı olarak adlandırılır.
Dikkatle ve keskin biçimde bakma, görme çekirdeğine bağlı kalıplaşmış bir kullanımdır.
Yavrunun gözünün açılıp görmeye hazır hale gelmesi de görme alanına bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı kalpteki kavrayış, bilgi, dinî doğrulanma, delil, ibret ve kişinin kendi aleyhine tanıklığı gibi bedensel olmayan anlama alanına yerleştirir. Göz duyusu burada çekirdek değildir; görme dili bilgi ve kalp idraki için kullanılır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İç bilgi, delil ve kavrayış alanıdır; çıplak gözle görme, kan, silah, taş ve dikiş anlamları dışarıda kalır.

concept_map.definition: Kalbin veya zihnin bir şeyi bilip kavraması, doğruluğa ermesi ve bunun delil, ibret ya da açıklayıcı kanıt olarak görünmesi. Din veya belirli bir iş konusunda bilinçli hale gelme bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, kalpte nüfuz eden kavrayış ve doğrulanmış anlayış çekirdektir.
Bu iç kavrayış delil, kanıt, ibret ve açıklayıcı bildirim anlamlarına uzanır.
Bir işte veya dinde bilinçli, kavrayış sahibi ve sağlam kanaatli olma özel bir kullanımdır.
Düşünüp tanıma ve kendini açık biçimde bilme bu bilgi alanına bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak iddiası dalı bilgi, kalbin nüfuzu, doğrulanmış kavrayış ve delil alanında birleştirir. Aynı malzeme dinî sağlam görüş, ibret ve açıklayıcı kanıt kullanımlarını da bu çekirdeğe bağlı gösterir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العلم بالشيء ونفاذ القلب والمعرفة والتحقق والاستبصار في الدين والحجة والعبرة وشهادة الإنسان على نفسه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد حاسة العين ولا اللمعان الحسي ولا الدم ولا السلاح ولا الحجارة ولا الخياطة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أحدهما العلم بالشيء وبصرت بالشيء إذا صرت به بصيرا عالما والبصيرة البرهان (maqayis)؛ البصر نفاذ في القلب والبصيرة اسم لما اعتقد في القلب من الدين وحقيق الأمر واستبصر في أمره ودينه (ayn;tahdhib)؛ حسن البصيرة إذا كان مستبصرا في دينه (jamhara)؛ البصر العلم وبصرت بالشيء علمته والتبصر التأمل والتعرف والبصيرة الحجة والاستبصار في الشيء (sihah)؛ لقوة القلب المدركة بصيرة وبصر وعلى معرفة وتحقق (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı yalnızca ışıklı oluşa indirmez; aydınlatan, açık kılan, kendisiyle görülen veya insanları görür hale getiren işlevleri birlikte verir. Bu yüzden dal kabul edilebilir, fakat tanım hem aydınlık hem de açıklayıcı işlevi birlikte taşımalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Görmeyi veya anlamayı mümkün kılan açıklıkla sınırlıdır; göz organı ya da yalın iç bilgi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak biçimin aydınlatıcı ve açıklayıcı işlevini verir; kalıba bağlı ayrı bir anlam genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin aydınlık, açık veya açıklayıcı olup görmeyi ya da anlamayı mümkün kılması. Bu alan, işaretin insanları görür veya kavrar hale getirmesiyle tanımlanır.

facets.statement: Aydınlatıcı veya açık kılıcı nitelik, görmeyi ve anlamayı mümkün kılar.
Bir işaretin insanları görür veya kavrar hale getirmesi bu çekirdeğin nedensel uzantısıdır.
Açıklama ve belirgin kılma eylemi aynı alan içinde kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda aydınlık, açıklık, kendisiyle görülme ve insanları görür hale getirme yönlerini bir araya getirir. Ayrıca açıklama ve belirgin kılma anlamı aynı toplu iddiada desteklenir.
